# Bank logos

Source: https://github.com/henriquezolini/react-bancos
Pinned commit: 03a805042d7f6931b95f717bbcdfbb75d5ec1d0b
Files: docs/icons/*.svg. Artwork is centered and fitted within consistent inner margins for small badges, preserving the original paths and proportions. Decorative background gradients are replaced with solid brand colors. Off-canvas artwork is removed from C6 and Neon. Itau retains its original composition.

Logos identify their respective institutions. Trademark ownership remains with each bank. See LICENSE.txt for source attribution and terms.
